dct_title_s: Carta particolareche mostra il Capo buona Speranza con il Mare Verso Ponte e con L'isole di Tristan D'Acunha e di Martin Vaz
dct_description_sm: Calligraphy covers much of the South Atlantic. A compass rose and two sailing vessels decorate the sea.

Norwich, I., Pam Kolbe, and Jeffrey C Stone. Norwich's Maps of Africa: An Illustrated and Annotated Carto-Bibliography. 2nd ed. / rev. and edited by Jeffrey C. Stone. Norwich, Vt.: Terra Nova Press, 1997, map 0247, p. 284
David Rumsey Map Center copy 1: Norwich no. NOR 0247.
